body.title: Karanja v Mwaura
body.summary: The court declined to enforce a termination clause exercisable by the lessor alone; notice must be mutual.
body.brief:
## Facts
The lessor served notice under a clause only it could invoke.

## Holding
The clause was read as mutual and the notice, short of the s. 57 minimum, was **void**.

## Rationale
- Mutuality of obligations.
- Statutory minimums bind the parties.
